card.description: Control whether {{roleLabel}} can access {{term}} and, if so, which {{many}} they see. Assignments made here union with any {{one}} assigned directly to a team member.

toggle.title: Enable {{term}}
toggle.description: Turn this on to give this role access to the {{term}} module and its sidebar entry.

assignment.title: Assigned {{term}}
assignment.description: Choose which channel partners every holder of this role can see. Leave empty to grant none.
assignment.emptyState: No {{many}} found for this institute yet.
assignment.chipUnresolvedTitle: This {{one}} (id: {{id}}) could not be found — it may have been deleted.
assignment.scopeNote: Every request for {{many}} — search, filters, pagination and totals — is scoped server-side to this list, plus any {{one}} assigned directly to a team member.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Fine-tune what this role can do with the {{term}} it can see.
permissions.screenOnlyTooltip: This only hides the action in the interface — the server does not separately enforce it.

canEditConfig.label: Edit {{one}} configuration
canEditConfig.hint: Allow changing settings for an existing partner.

canManageTeam.label: Manage team
canManageTeam.hint: Allow adding or removing members of a {{one}}'s team.

canViewFinance.label: View finance
canViewFinance.hint: Allow viewing payment and payout details.

adminNote: Admins always see every {{one}} — this role's access can't be narrowed below full visibility.
